title: Eggplant Gratin
description: A Mediterranean-inspired eggplant gratin, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe combines the rich flavors of roasted eggplant with a crispy, cheesy topping.
instructions: Cut the eggplant into 1/2-inch thick slices and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the eggplant is tender and lightly browned.
In a separate bowl, mix together the Mediterranean cheese blend and gratin.
To assemble the gratin, create a layer of eggplant slices in a baking dish.
Top the eggplant with the cheese mixture and repeat the process until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Bake for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
